title: A heavier object on the circle
hook: Change mass and predict centripetal force.
misconception: centripetal force stays fixed when mass doubles.
objective: Apply F_c = mv²/r to compare centripetal force when mass changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With uniform circular motion with fixed speed and radius, F_c = mv²/r. When mass doubles, centripetal force becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model F_c = mv²/r; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider uniform circular motion with fixed speed and radius, with a nonzero initial result. If mass triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on centripetal force?
recall.why: Apply F_c = mv²/r under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
